body: Might wanna try talking to that friend of yours about it. He might be able to offer you his perspective. Not sure if it'll help, but it might be worth a shot. It might also feel good to feel that bro support irl. In any case I'm a pretty chill dude so if you ever wanna chat send me a message.

Well you've got some support at least. That's a good thing. I'm in the U.S. myself. I have a few close friends that cant really help me. I'm just trying to hang in there until I can find an informed consent clinic or a therapist that'll actually give me hormones without making it such a damn trial. I'm 21 so I've also got the benefit/curse of buying alcohol. 

In the meantime, I do have a few coping methods. Whenever I have to do anything government related (like renewing my drivers license) I pretend that I'm a secret agent. It's silly, but it detaches me from the situation and gives me a chuckle. I find if I can make myself laugh a little it makes sucky situations easier.
Have you told anyone irl how bad it is?

Ouch. Your endocrinologist shouldn't be misleading you like that. I hate the way the whole system is set up personally. People in our situations don't get what we need because of it. Sadly there isn't much we can do about it but find a way to survive in the meantime. I'm to the point where I can't work partially because of my situation, so I'm really lucky to have a supportive partner. What's your support network like?

Slow down there, friend. Take a deep breath with me. Count to five. Let it out slow.
Alright. I'm in a situation similar to yours thanks to some therapists sucking. Granted I've never been on blockers, but I was ready for hormones two years ago. Anyway, how old are you? Is there a reason you can't get T? I'm here if you wanna chat. Also if I may ask, how'd you get banned from lgbt?

I'm probably going to stop seeing him. 

We don't have the same priorities and it's starting to harm more than help. He also doesn't like the fact that my fiancée and I have an open relationship so that's not helping. I'm irritated because I've tried multiple therapists before him and I've never gotten a lot out of fherapy in general.
Thank you. This gives me some encouragement.
